Jordan / team — attached are our drafts:
- boundary-illustration-v2.pdf (annotated rack-level schematic showing control vs data ownership, management-plane ACLs, NAT/egress point, and recommended public/private subnet mapping)
- ops-checklist.xlsx (pre-cutover acceptance items and quick smoke test commands)

High-level notes included on slide 2 of the PDF:
- Control plane (Redwood-managed): API endpoints, k8s control plane for runtime, model-serving control endpoints, and the KV cache service. These should be reachable from Redwood VPN (we recommend an IPsec tunnel to a Redwood-managed gateway).
- Data plane (Acme-managed rack connectivity): inference nodes will be colocated within Acme racks but operate in a tenant VLAN. Egress from inference nodes should traverse the Acme egress stack and be subject to Acme DLP policies.
- Suggested NAT placement: put NAT at the Acme egress edge so tokenized outbound traffic appears from Acme range (helps audit).

Open questions for the on-site integrator:
1) Do they need a dedicated OOB (out-of-band) management link for the Redwood runtime? If yes, we recommend a separate management VLAN with dual-homed paths.
2) Is the colo comfortable distributing a short-lived client certificate bundle from our private CA, or do they require a cross-signed cert from their CA?

Attachments: boundary-illustration-v2.pdf, ops-checklist.xlsx (see Drive link also).

If this looks good, Vivek can send the packet to Jordan and cc colo ops.

— Neha
Staff Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

(attachment stubs: boundary-illustration-v2.pdf (PDF, 2 pages), ops-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet))

1) We do prefer a dedicated OOB management link for the initial cutover; TelcoOps will provision a management VLAN and out-of-band console access for the staging rack.
2) We can accept a cross-signed cert from our CA for the initial rollout; long-term we can coordinate on mutual trust with the Acme PKI team.

Next steps: Vivek, please send the PDF + checklist to the colo ops lead (ops-lead@telcoops.net) and mark the ticket in our system (ACME-TKT-4289). If you can include the Drive link and a short runbook snippet for the smoke tests, that will speed things on site.
